invariants.rationale: The method always returns a non-null Iterator<List<WriteStatus>> (either via Collections.singletonList(...).iterator() or IOUtils.runMerge(...)).
partitionPath is always provided as an argument to getUpdateHandle(...), which requires a non-null value to function correctly.
fileId is always logged or used in getUpdateHandle or IOUtils.runMerge, so it is expected to be non-null.
If the record iterator is empty, result is singleton iterator, else it is result of runMerge, both are non-null.
Result is always an Iterator at method exit.
